name: Obol
desc: A small silver coin, the kind laid in a dead man's mouth to pay the ferryman.

name: Ox Head
desc: The head of a great black ox. Thor once baited a hook with one.

name: Gargoyle Fang
desc: A chipped stone fang from a cathedral waterspout. Evil is said to keep its distance.

name: Bronze Law Tablet
desc: One of the bronze tablets of Minos's laws that Talos carried round the villages of Crete.

name: Troll Silver
desc: A lump of the silver trolls hoard under the mountain. Count it twice.

name: Labrys
desc: A bronze double axe from the palace at Knossos. Some say the Labyrinth is named after it.

name: Nanna's Ring
desc: A gold finger-ring that Baldr's wife Nanna sent up out of Hel as a gift.

name: Burst Stone
desc: A pebble split clean in two by a basilisk's breath. Don't sniff it.

name: Midgard Scale
desc: A single scale off the Midgard Serpent, as big as a shield and as cold as the deep sea.

name: Hart's Ember
desc: A spark from Furfur's burning tail. He swore it was lucky. He lies about everything.

name: Bottled Fanfare
desc: Uncork it and a trumpet plays, though there is nothing in the bottle you can see.

name: Ring of Virtues
desc: A ring Asmodeus gives to those who call him properly, says the Goetia. Which virtues, it doesn't say.
